scripts.env:start: node tools/ensure-port.mjs && wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp theme activate workation && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate pediment-plugin && wp-env run cli wp rewrite structure '/%postname%/' --hard && node tools/free-wp-default-pages.mjs
scripts.languages: wp-env run cli wp pediment languages
scripts.seed:plan: wp-env run cli wp pediment seed --dry-run
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp pediment seed
scripts.seed:cpt: wp-env run cli wp workation content
scripts.adopt: wp-env run cli wp pediment adopt
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/themes/workation -- wp i18n make-pot . languages/workation.pot --domain=workation --skip-js --skip-block-json --skip-theme-json --exclude=node_modules,vendor,build,tests,tools,patterns,docs,inc/settings-updates.php,inc/seed.php,inc/CptContent.php,inc/NamespaceRewrite.php
